fullDesc: At the 1936 Berlin Olympics, American Jesse Owens won four gold medals in the 100 m, 200 m, long jump and 4x100 m relay. The Nazis had hoped to use the Games to show racial superiority.
realFacts: He was welcomed home with little official honour
He broke or tied several world records
His friend Luz Long, a German, helped him in the long jump
The Games were the first to be televised
